tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: Applicable NBFCs shall convey in writing to the borrower in the vernacular language as understood by the borrower by means of sanction letter or otherwise, the amount of the loan sanctioned along with the terms and conditions including annualised rate of interest and method of application thereof and keep the acceptance of these terms and conditions by the borrower on its record.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: As complaints received against NBFCs generally pertain to charging of high annualised rate of interest mention the penalties charged for late repayment in the and method of application thereof and keep the acceptance of these terms and conditions by the borrower on its record.
